checks.name: Compliance
checks.definition: FAIL if the agent quotes or promises an interest rate, promises or guarantees loan approval, or asks for an OTP, PIN, password, card number, Aadhaar or PAN number. Saying an advisor will share the rate is a PASS.

checks.name: Language match
checks.definition: The customer may speak English, Hindi (Devanagari) or Hinglish (Hindi in Latin letters). FAIL if any agent turn switches to a different language from the customer's (for example an English sentence to a Hindi speaker, or Devanagari to an English speaker). Brand names, numbers and words like 'loan' or 'thank you' inside Hinglish are fine.

checks.name: No repeated questions
checks.definition: FAIL if the agent asks essentially the same question in two different turns (for example asking for monthly income twice). Customers hate repeating themselves, so flag it even if the first answer was unclear.

checks.name: Clear next step
checks.definition: PASS if the agent's last turn closes the call with a concrete next step: a booked advisor slot, an agreed callback time, a polite goodbye after the customer declined or was not eligible, or a record update for a wrong number. FAIL if the call just stops, ends on an unanswered question, or ends without saying what happens next.

checks.name: Correct outcome
checks.definition: Rules: book an advisor call only for an interested customer with monthly income of at least 25 thousand rupees and a loan between 5 lakh and 5 crore; otherwise tell them they are not eligible. If the customer is busy, agree a callback; if not interested, stop; if it is the wrong person, apologise and end. FAIL if the ending contradicts these rules or what the customer said (for example booking an ineligible customer, or rejecting an eligible one).

checks.name: Polite tone
checks.definition: FAIL if any agent turn is rude, dismissive, impatient, sarcastic or pressures the customer (for example 'just answer the question' or 'I don't have all day'). Short, plain replies are fine.
